prompt:
STYLE-TRANSFER REPAINT, ONE FULL ENVIRONMENT BACKGROUND, 1672x941 landscape opaque.
INPUT ROLES:
Image 1 is the HEGUANG COURTYARD EDIT TARGET. Preserve its scene composition, elevated camera, large-scale color families and physical layout: clear paved logistics yard, kitchen left, storage bays across middle, repair bay right, broad cart path bending behind left rock shoulder, separate flat-landed stairs to upper-right affairs hall, stream below left. All door thresholds still meet actual ground. Do not add buildings or change road connections.
Images 2, 3 and 4 are the project's ACTUAL INVENTORY ICONS: porcelain bottle, simple cloth-bound book and dark iron. They are the PRIMARY PAINTING / MATERIAL STYLE reference. Their transparent/dark preview backgrounds and object subjects must NOT be inserted into the scene.

USER CRITICISM: the target landscape is covered with ugly repetitive pale dots, white flecks and granular decorative mottling. COMPLETELY REPAINT those surface treatments. Do not simply blur, smooth-filter, recolor or lightly retouch Image 1. Repaint in the inventory icons' hand-painted watercolor/gouache-like broad layered pigment shapes, matte volume, confident soft gray-brown contours and readable material planes. Use substantial strokes that follow object forms. A rock has a few large light/mid/shadow planes like the iron icon, not hundreds of little beige lichen dots. A tree canopy is a coherent olive-green mass with a few broad painted shadow/color patches, not hundreds of individual round yellow/white leaf-tip specks. Timber has broad local-color shading and only a few structural grain marks like book cover/bottle brushwork. Ivory stone and plaster have broad quiet cream/gray planes, no pointillist highlights.
IMPORTANT ZERO DOT TEXTURE: NO white spots, cream/gold speckling, lichen-dot pattern, glitter, stippling, tiny colored dots, snow-like flecks, sparkling foliage, dense scratches, noisy paper grain or decorative dot edges anywhere. Remove the reference scene's scattered tiny pink/white blossoms entirely; replace them with plain understated olive foliage, not a flower-speckled canopy. No repeated tiny yellow leaf dots. Roof highlights are muted bluegray local-color planes, not every tile outlined with bright yellow. Gold eave fittings are understated brushed bronze-ochre, no bright metallic glare. Keep rock and tree surfaces QUIET and organized.
The icons use brush texture at a coherent broad scale, NOT pixel noise, an oil impasto mess or plastic 3D shading. Retain clear silhouettes, believable volumes, gentle diffuse light, subtle layered painted color. Not flat vector or cel-shaded cartoon, not photographic, not detailed miniature pen engraving.
Keep current gray-blue roofs/rocks, warm light stone yard and olive green pine colors; use object LOCAL COLOR for soft shadows rather than bright white dots. Do NOT make every material porcelain, white ceramic or iron just because icons are references. No new warm/yellow film or cold/purple color grade, no excessive desaturation. Retain grand refined Daoist sect architecture and defined physical supports, no peasant huts.
Simplify repetitive tiles, lattice and cobblestone seams to a few selected readable marks. Most ground paving has quiet broad colored planes with subtle partial stone joint lines, no high-frequency grid filling every inch. Important edges/doors/stair landings still crisp. All four corners fully painted and clear, NO peripheral blur, fog feathering, white fade, vignette or depth of field.
No people, figures/humanoid statues, readable text, labels, calligraphy, UI, watermarks, frames or glows. Environment only, full rectangular opaque background, not an inventory object floating on transparency. Generate only ONE scene as a style sample.
